spec_match.rationale: Uses audioStartTime/audioEndTime exactly as the explainer's timeline-association use case describes, guards isFinal, and treats null timing as unpositioned rather than inventing placement.

interactive.rationale: Start listening, a clearly-tagged sample walkthrough, and clear all drive a rendered timeline plus caption list; the live path feature-detects the attributes per result rather than assuming them.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The blurb promises timeline placement of recognised phrases the way a captioning tool would, which is what the page implements.

edge_cases.rationale: Null start/end (flagged unpositioned, never dropped at a made-up spot), no-SR browsers, recognition errors, start() throwing, interim results, and pagehide cleanup are all handled.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus 5811907077472256 (verified) and the explainer's problem-statement anchor are linked.

conformance.rationale: The all-manual suite matches the page's honesty rules: no timestamp may be fabricated or inferred from event cadence, which is exactly what the unpositioned branch enforces.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI: initial empty timeline, axis, and caption placeholder verified with clean console (fonts.googleapis.com failure environmental); there is no autorun/URL-param hook, so the sample walkthrough and timeline rendering were not observed live.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts cover no-SR, null-timing, positioned segments, errors, and sample runs, plus injected global error capture.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout; timeline segments use accent-blue with ivory text (~7.7:1) and the SAMPLE tag is black-on-ivory — no contrast or override violations found.

accessibility.rationale: The caption list is an aria-live ordered list mirroring every segment (with times) as text, the track has a role=img label, unpositioned entries are labelled in text, and all controls are native buttons with visible focus.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Harness-validated ok/ok recorded in responsive-support.json (2026-07-25); the track scales percentage-based and the code pre scrolls in place; this session's own 360px CLI capture is inconclusive due to the headless min-width clamp.

openQuestions.title: Keep the timeline's accessible label in sync with its contents
openQuestions.detail: The track keeps the static label 'Audio timeline of recognised caption segments' while segments are only exposed via hover titles; the caption list does mirror everything, but updating the role=img label with '<n> segments over <t> s' after render would make the visual and non-visual states match. Consider also an autorun query param (e.g. ?sample=1) so automated verifiers can exercise the sample walkthrough.

summary: A faithful implementation of the explainer's captioning use case with exemplary null-handling honesty (unpositioned captions are flagged, never guessed) and a clearly-tagged sample walkthrough that keeps the demo useful before the proposal ships. Only minor polish remains. Verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshots, DOM, clean console); controls could not be clicked and there is no autorun hook, so the rendered-timeline state was verified by code trace only.
